option_relations.rationale: The option describes primary hyperparathyroidism with osteitis fibrosa cystica and brown tumor, which is closely related to the leaf label 'brown tumor of primary hyperparathyroidism'.
The option 'Brown tumor of hyperparathyroidism' is a subtype of the leaf 'brown tumor of primary hyperparathyroidism'.
The option 'Parathyroid carcinoma' is not directly related to the leaf 'brown tumor of primary hyperparathyroidism'.

The option 'Brown tumor secondary to primary hyperparathyroidism due to parathyroid carcinoma' is a subtype of the leaf 'brown tumor of primary hyperparathyroidism', but with an additional specification of the cause.
